# samples

The reified form is a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeSample`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeSample.md).
